study_name: DAYTRADE-003B: Stocks-in-Play 5-Minute Opening Range Breakout Preregistration

primary_paper.title: A Profitable Day Trading Strategy For The U.S. Equity Market
primary_paper.series: Swiss Finance Institute Research Paper No. 24-98

secondary_corroboration.author: Andrea Barbon
secondary_corroboration.institution: University of St. Gallen / Swiss Finance Institute

secondary_corroboration.source: QuantConnect: Opening Range Breakout for Stocks in Play
secondary_corroboration.author: Derek Melchin
secondary_corroboration.known_universe_divergence: 1,000 liquid equities instead of ~7,000 source universe

source_evidence_period.description: Historical sample analyzed in the primary source paper; prior literature evidence only

universe_contract.description: Point-in-time U.S.-listed NYSE and Nasdaq equities consistent with Zarattini et al. (2024), subject to basic eligibility filters
universe_contract.source_crsp_survivorship_statement: Source used CRSP to avoid survivorship bias, including delisted securities; approximately 7,000 U.S. equities on NYSE and Nasdaq (2016-2023). Primary paper does not state an explicit limitation to common stocks.
universe_contract.security_type_inclusion_status: Unresolved mapping for TradeX: exact CRSP security-type inclusion/exclusion mapping (ADRs, REITs, closed-end funds, multiple share classes, etc.) to be determined in DAYTRADE-003C
universe_contract.tradex_operational_adaptation_rule: A smaller operational universe (such as top 1,000) would constitute a VARIANT requiring explicit Gary/ChatGPT approval and is not authorized here
universe_contract.constituent_resolution_policy: Point-in-time historical constituent membership, delistings, mergers, and ticker changes are data-feasibility requirements to be evaluated in DAYTRADE-003C

relative_volume_ranking.numerator: opening_range_volume(D, j) [total volume in first 5 minutes of session D for security j]
relative_volume_ranking.denominator: mean(opening_range_volume(D-k, j)) over k=1..14 completed eligible sessions for j
relative_volume_ranking.fewer_than_top_n_rule: If fewer than 20 symbols satisfy all filters and RV >= 1.0, trade only the qualifying symbols
relative_volume_ranking.tie_breaker_label: TradeX determinism rule, not published alpha rule

fields.or_open: first executable regular-session price / 09:30 bar open
fields.or_volume: total traded volume across completed 09:30-09:34 bars

entry_order.order_lifetime_interpretation: Order remains active during regular trading session until filled or canceled at regular-session close (locked TradeX execution convention AMB-04)

stop_loss.atr_input: 14-day ATR from completed sessions D-1 and earlier

exit_rules.stop_hit_exit: Exit immediately at stop execution price subject to execution model
exit_rules.session_close_exit: Close all open positions at end of regular trading session
exit_rules.one_minute_eod_convention: Completed 15:59-16:00 bar close liquidation convention locked as TradeX execution rule (Option A; non-blocking)

position_sizing.source_published_language: Each stock was sized so that if the stop were hit, the loss on the capital deployed for that position would be approximately 1%, subject to a 4x leverage constraint. Initial capital $25,000.
position_sizing.concurrent_portfolio_sizing_semantics: Source does not detail mathematical portfolio NAV compounding or concurrent position margin allocation when multiple of the 20 setups trigger; preserved under AMB-03 for resolution in DAYTRADE-003C.

holdout.exclusion_note: October 2026 excluded because month is incomplete at design time

data_contract.source_intraday_data_citation: IQFeed regular-session intraday data, explicitly unadjusted for stock splits and dividends

point_in_time_discipline.trailing_history_boundary: Completed trading session D-1 and earlier only
point_in_time_discipline.current_session_close_exclusion: Current session D close never enters ATR or daily volume history
point_in_time_discipline.universe_membership: Point-in-time constituent status with zero survivorship or lookahead bias
point_in_time_discipline.corporate_actions_policy: Consistent adjustment across daily and intraday series; split adjustments must not cause threshold distortion

long_stop_at_p.step_1_open_trigger: If bar.open >= P: fill at bar.open
long_stop_at_p.step_2_intrabar_trigger: Else if bar.high >= P: fill at P
long_stop_at_p.step_3_no_fill: Else: NO FILL (order remains active subject to locked order-lifetime rule)

short_stop_at_p.step_1_open_trigger: If bar.open <= P: fill at bar.open
short_stop_at_p.step_2_intrabar_trigger: Else if bar.low <= P: fill at P
short_stop_at_p.step_3_no_fill: Else: NO FILL (order remains active subject to locked order-lifetime rule)

stop_entry_trigger_and_fill.equality_handling: Uses >= and <= so that an opening print exactly at the stop level is executable
stop_entry_trigger_and_fill.label: TRADEX_EXECUTION_RULE

stop_loss_gap_through.rule: If price gaps beyond protective stop level, fill at worse executable opening price rather than assuming exact stop price
stop_loss_gap_through.label: TRADEX_EXECUTION_RULE

same_bar_entry_and_stop.rule: If a 1-minute bar triggers entry and touches the protective stop in the same bar and intrabar path cannot be proven, conservatively assume entry occurred and the stop was triggered (worst-case fail closed)
same_bar_entry_and_stop.label: TRADEX_EXECUTION_RULE

stop_activation_timing.rule: Protective stop is economically active immediately upon hypothetical entry fill; no unprotected 1-minute window permitted
stop_activation_timing.label: TRADEX_EXECUTION_RULE

scenario_a_source_comparison.purpose: Direct comparability to published Zarattini et al. (2024) headline results

scenario_b_tradex_primary.purpose: Primary decision and validation gate evaluation

scenario_c_stress.purpose: Robustness diagnostic; failure does not automatically invalidate formal support

disposition_taxonomy.INVALID: Material methodology, point-in-time, universe, data-quality, or execution-integrity failure
disposition_taxonomy.INCONCLUSIVE: Evidence is insufficient or materially non-computable (fails evidence-sufficiency gate)
disposition_taxonomy.NOT_SUPPORTED: Adequate evidence indicates the strategy does not produce positive economics under TradeX primary costs (mean daily net return <= 0)
disposition_taxonomy.PROMISING_NOT_CONFIRMED: Primary point estimate is economically positive (mean daily net return > 0), but statistical uncertainty prevents formal support (95% CI lower bound <= 0)
disposition_taxonomy.SUPPORTED: All preregistered validation gates pass: integrity, sufficiency, primary economics (>0), and 95% CI lower bound > 0

integrity_gate.condition: Zero material point-in-time, lookahead, universe, or execution-integrity violations

holdout_access_rule.action_if_validation_not_supported: Holdout partition 2026-01-02 through 2026-09-30 remains strictly unopened, unread, and unacquired
holdout_access_rule.re_testing_prohibition: Any follow-on hypothesis generated by validation requires a new preregistered strategy/version and new untouched evidence

parameter_fishing_prohibitions: Testing opening range durations other than 5 minutes (e.g. 1m, 2m, 3m, 10m, 15m)
Changing top-N selection from Top 20 (e.g. Top 10, Top 30)
Replacing absolute $0.50 ATR with ATR percentage or different dollar threshold
Modifying 14-day average volume filter from 1,000,000 shares
Adding technical indicators (VWAP, EMAs, RSI, MACD, etc.)
Adding news, sentiment, or social feeds
Adding profit targets or take-profit orders
Altering stop loss distance from 0.10 * ATR14
Adding trailing stops or breakeven stops
Restricting direction to long-only or short-only after inspecting results
Selecting favorable sectors or market capitalization bands post-hoc
Restricting trades to favorable times of day
Optimizing friction, commissions, or slippage models

unresolved_source_ambiguities.source_explicit: Approximately 7,000 U.S. equities, NYSE and Nasdaq, 2016-2023, survivorship-bias-free CRSP universe, delisted names included
unresolved_source_ambiguities.still_unresolved_for_tradex: Exact CRSP security-type mapping needed to reproduce the source universe: treatment of ADRs, REITs, closed-end funds, multiple share classes, and other security-type edge cases

unresolved_source_ambiguities.description: Paper specifies 14-day ATR > $0.50 and 0.10 * ATR stop distance, but does not specify whether Wilder smoothing, exponential smoothing, or simple 14-day rolling mean was used
unresolved_source_ambiguities.proposed_tradex_convention: Standard Wilder ATR14 on completed D-1 daily bars

unresolved_source_ambiguities.topic: Concurrent-Portfolio 1% Deployed Capital Risk Sizing Mathematics
unresolved_source_ambiguities.source_explicit: Each stock sized so that if stop hit, loss on capital deployed for that position would be 1%, subject to 4x leverage constraint
unresolved_source_ambiguities.still_unresolved_for_tradex: Mathematical formula for portfolio NAV compounding, pro-rata scaling, and margin consumption when up to 20 concurrent trades are active

unresolved_source_ambiguities.description: Paper implies entry stop orders remain active intraday until hit or EOD exit; does not define an earlier cutoff
unresolved_source_ambiguities.locked_convention: Stop order remains active from 09:35 ET until filled or session close (16:00 ET)

unresolved_source_ambiguities.description: Source backtest resolution (1m vs 5m vs tick) is unknown, but non-blocking because TradeX explicitly evaluates against locked conservative 1-minute execution rules
Handling of gap-through fills on stop-entry and stop-loss orders in discrete 1-minute bars
unresolved_source_ambiguities.locked_convention: Conservative 3-step conditional trigger rules: fill at worse open if gap-through occurs

unresolved_source_ambiguities.topic: Same-Bar Entry and Stop Path Collision
unresolved_source_ambiguities.description: Intrabar path ambiguity when both entry and stop price levels are touched within the same 1-minute bar
unresolved_source_ambiguities.locked_convention: Conservative fail-closed assumption: entry triggered, stop hit in same bar; reported in same_bar_ambiguity_count

unresolved_source_ambiguities.description: Paper specifies positions liquidated at market close (4:00 PM)
unresolved_source_ambiguities.locked_convention: Completed 15:59-16:00 1-minute bar close liquidation convention locked as TradeX execution rule (Option A; non-blocking)

unresolved_source_ambiguities.topic: Commission Fee Structure & Minimum Ticket Fees
unresolved_source_ambiguities.description: Paper cites $0.0035/share (Interactive Brokers tiered); must determine whether IBKR ticket minimums ($0.35 or $1.00) materially affect small share positions in TradeX

unresolved_source_ambiguities.topic: Corporate Action Adjustment Consistency Between Daily and Intraday Data
unresolved_source_ambiguities.source_explicit: Intraday stock data from IQFeed were unadjusted for stock splits and dividends
unresolved_source_ambiguities.still_unresolved_for_tradex: Exact daily-data adjustment convention for ATR and average-volume calculations (split-only vs total return in CRSP); how daily inputs and unadjusted intraday data were aligned across splits; and what deterministic TradeX convention reproduces internally consistent prices
